## 50.0 — Main orchestrator (TEST prototype)
Select SAME Postgres credential in all 3 PostgreSQL nodes. Run 50.2 Pricing points to existing workflow ID wdfox50ragquote01. 50.2 requires the Receive Pricing Request trigger and dynamic Test Request patch installed by setup script.
Manual trigger uses one navigation sample; internal trigger requires request_id, instruction, quantity, environment=TEST. No public webhook. No caller-controlled tenant; this pilot supports only test-owner / Jobcenter.
Orders and quote snapshots persist in wdfox_test.client_requests. Request ID cannot be reused with changed contents. Re-pricing is allowed only for draft states.
No site edits, approval recording, invoices, payments or deployments implemented yet. No need to publish. Check Order Report and stored draft before adding next stages.
